scope: Reusable property contracts only; no project equipment selection or size
port_rules: An individual positive/negative conductor is different from an aggregated DC circuit bundle.
A logical shutdown command port does not mandate a dedicated control wire; actual PLC/wired/other method needs evidence.
A microinverter, optimizer or module glyph alone proves no shutdown, backup or grid-forming function.
Internal module marks in a string glyph do not specify series count.
rating_input_topics: module power/Voc/Isc and applicable temperature coefficients
